featureType.name: MaC_3-15_SRW_tracking_SSM_pts
featureType.title: Interpolated tracking movements of Southern right whales from SSM - points (NESP MaC 3.15)
featureType.abstract: Interpolated positions of four southern right whales satellite tagged in Encounter Bay, SA in June 2024. Locations are predicted at six-hour intervals using a state-space model, together with dive metrics summarised for the three hours before and after each modelled location.
